Returns the creative inventory category of the given item.
Takes an item key as input.
Set "as_key" to true to return the category key (minecraft:building_blocks) instead of the display name.
Returns an empty value when the player is not in a world.
Returns "UNKNOWN" if the item has no category or is invalid.

Returns the current real-world day of the month.

Values:
- timezone: Timezone to use for this placeholder. Defaults to 'system'. It is recommended to use IANA timezone IDs here. A good website to see all IANA IDs is https://nodatime.org/TimeZones

Returns the current real-world hour.
